journey.name: Pull to refresh the inbox
journey.description: Start: the Mailflare v2 inbox is open and signed in, scrolled to the top. Pulling the list down refreshes it in place; it must not trigger a full page reload.

actions.action: Swipe slowly downwards starting on the first conversation row, ending near the middle of the screen
Verify that a refresh indicator appears at the top of the list, or that the list has refreshed
Verify that the inbox is still shown with the "Inbox" heading and the message list, and that no sign-in page or browser error page is shown
